description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 4730016277232 ADAPTER,STRAIGHT,PI: Line 0001 Qty 137 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0062 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract).
